name: Compute Cluster
description: SLURM compute-cluster integration over a tailnet (or any reachable network). Owns /api/cluster/{settings,hosts,test-ssh,ssh-key} HTTP routes, cluster SSH key management at /data/.ssh/id_cluster, and the ref-compute-cluster knowledge node. Tailscale plugin is optional but recommended — without it, clusters reachable only via MagicDNS won't resolve. Reads cluster config from the host slot (clusterUsername/LoginHost/TmuxPrefix/Hosts) populated by SPORE_CLUSTER_* env vars.
